# list_available_agent_resources_tool

> AGENT CREATION ONLY: Lists available resources for building NEW agents.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `agents` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=list_available_agent_resources_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

AGENT CREATION ONLY: Lists available resources for building NEW agents. This tool is specifically
designed for the agent creation process and should NOT be used by agents to discover what resources
they have access to during runtime.

IMPORTANT: If you are an agent trying to understand your own capabilities, you should only use
the resources that were explicitly passed to you in your configuration. Do NOT use this tool to
discover available resources for yourself.

This tool is ONLY for:
- Listing resources when creating a new agent
- Understanding resource options during agent configuration
- Preparing agent resource lists before agent creation

System resources are built-in resources like role_types_resource, etc.
Custom resources are user-created resources stored in the database.

Resources provide data or content to agents and come in two types:
- Executable resources: Run JavaScript code to generate dynamic content
- Static content resources: Provide fixed text content

Returns detailed information about each resource including:
- Resource name and description
- Resource type (system/custom)
- For custom resources: whether it's static content or executable
- Content preview for static resources
- Creation and update timestamps

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `include_inactive` | boolean | no | Include inactive custom resources (default: false) |
| `resource_type` | string | no | Filter by resource type: system, custom, or all (default: all) |
